cards.title: Task initiation ramp
cards.summary: Lower friction until the first physical action is obvious.
cards.when_to_use: Knowing what to do but being unable to start.
steps: Name the first physical action.
Shrink it to two minutes or less.
Put needed materials in reach.
Use one start cue.
Stop after minimum if energy is depleted.

cards.title: Make time visible
cards.summary: Externalize time instead of relying on internal time sense.
steps: Use a visible clock/timer.
Set transition alarms before the true deadline.
Add realistic setup and travel buffers.
Leave a written next-step marker before switching tasks.

cards.title: External working memory
cards.summary: Move fragile information out of memory and into the environment.
cards.when_to_use: Forgetting steps, losing track, or juggling too many mental items.
steps: Capture tasks in one trusted place.
Keep active steps visible.
Use checklists for repeated routines.
Reduce the number of simultaneous open loops.

cards.title: Body doubling plan
cards.summary: Use another person or shared presence as an initiation/attention scaffold.
cards.when_to_use: Starting or sustaining tasks is easier with social presence.
steps: Choose a safe person or virtual room.
State the task and work interval.
Keep conversation minimal if distracting.
Check in at the end on next step, not moral performance.

cards.title: Shame reset
cards.summary: Separate executive-function difficulty from character judgment.
cards.when_to_use: After missed tasks, lateness, clutter, or inconsistency triggers shame.
steps: Describe what happened without labels.
Name the executive barrier.
Change one environmental support.
Repair any impact that needs repair.
Restart with a smaller next action.

cards.title: Hyperfocus exit ramp
cards.summary: Create cues that help transition out of absorbing activity.
cards.when_to_use: Missing meals, sleep, appointments, or body needs during hyperfocus.
steps: Set external alarms before starting.
Place a visible stop note in the work area.
At alarm, save state and write the exact re-entry point.
Do one body/basic-needs check.
Return only if the planned window allows.
